_note: Dual-gate N-channel MOSFET (MOS tetrode), depletion mode: one channel under two gates in series, gate 1 next to the source, gate 2 next to the drain. 4-terminal: drain, gate2, gate1, source. Engine (bw-board dual_gate_mosfet): two level-1 nmos halves on an internal node, pinch-off vp (default -1.2 V, vp1/vp2 per half) and k (default 5 mA/V^2 per half, k1/k2), lambda 0.02. Conducts with both gates at the source potential; either gate below pinch-off cuts the channel; at small Vds the channel is a voltage-controlled resistor. Reports vg1s, vg2s, vds and which gate pinched it.
